caption: The drawing features four square panels arranged in a 2x2 grid on a plain beige background. The top left panel is patterned with a black lattice design on a white background, forming diamond shapes with small orange circles at the intersections. The top right panel consists of a brown geometric web-like pattern with star shapes radiating from red dots at the intersections, on a beige background. The bottom left panel displays a series of vertical stripes in dark brown, white, and red, including thin lines, dotted lines, scalloped edges, leaf motifs, and circular and floral decorations in red and white. The bottom right panel shows an ornate, symmetrical design in white lines on a deep brown background, resembling stylized plant or floral forms interspersed with small, regularly spaced white dots.
title: Materials from Quilt
